method: Original PDF coordinate/column pair extraction with PyMuPDF (not repaired clean tiers or evidence calculations), original full-document applicant disclosures, source-page quote comparison; integer multiplication and summation. Hash-bound bytes checked against repair manifest.

records.unit: individual Shares / H Shares as labelled, no thousands or board-lot scaling
records.scope: col_CO only; no semantic approval of other fields
records.notes: Independently paired first two numeric table columns by original PDF word bounding boxes and common baseline, preserving page continuations; wrapped allocation/ballot lines and totals excluded. Both ordinary-public pools counted once. Original page text confirms share unit and public-applicant disclosure. Candidate and evidence read only after coordinate recomputation.
